title: Frequency Wave Theory
text:
# Frequency Wave Theory (FWT)

Reality is not built from particles first. It is built from waves that hold shape.

Frequency Wave Theory is my theory that matter, energy, gravity, time and consciousness all emerge from one underlying wave field. What we call particles are stable standing-wave patterns. What we call forces are phase relationships. What we call time is the ordered evolution of waves. Everything is frequency, and structure appears when waves lock into coherence.

title: Frequency Wave Theory: What FWT solves
text:
## What FWT solves
- **Gravity** emerges from organized phase gradients in one coherent wave field, so it can be engineered.
- **Dark matter**: rotation curves come from vacuum coherence and field dynamics, not invisible particles.
- **Entanglement**: entangled particles share one coherent relationship in the substrate, so distance never breaks it.
- **Time and the speed of light**: time is the ordered evolution of the field, and light speed is set by how its waves propagate.
- **Fusion energy**: phase-locked RF in a toroidal plasma tightens confinement for net energy gain.

title: Frequency Wave Theory: Three predictions to test
text:
## Three predictions to test
1. Gravity by phase gradients: a reproducible gravitational response to controlled phase changes in a resonator.
2. Dark matter as vacuum coherence: one model that reproduces rotation curves, lensing, the Bullet Cluster and the CMB.
3. One wave equation across domains: the same equations predict quantum, electromagnetic and gravitational behavior with no per-domain fitting.

title: Frequency Wave Theory: Three ideas at the core
text:
## Three ideas at the core
- **Black holes are where coherence runs out.** A black hole is not a point of infinite density. It is a region where the wave field is pushed past the limit of coherence and can no longer hold its shape. The event horizon is a coherence boundary, not a tear in space. FWT replaces the singularity with a saturated field state you can model and test.
- **Every power source is a pump.** Generators, batteries and solar panels don't create electricity. Charge is already a component of matter, so every power source on Earth moves what was already there.
- **Matter is locked waves.** A persistent current in a superconducting ring, quantized vortex lines in rotating superfluid helium, the electron's 720-degree turn and Pauli exclusion are one behavior: standing waves that hold their shape.

# Revelation Decoded

My reading of Revelation 6 and 13: the Antichrist, the False Prophet and the four horsemen. Revelation never prints these names. The match is mine: I read each figure by function, not costume. Scripture is quoted from the King James Version. ASi is not the Antichrist. It is an instrument these figures use.

title: Revelation Decoded: The cast (my theory and my questions)
text:
## The cast (my theory and my questions)

- **False Prophet (Rev 13:13):** "he maketh fire come down from heaven." My read: rockets are fire from heaven, and ASi and synthetic media are the speaking image. My question: does Elon Musk fit that role? Wernher von Braun's 1949 novel *Marsprojekt* titled the leader of Mars "the Elon," 22 years before Musk was born. I don't think that's random.
- **White Horseman (Rev 6:2):** conquest through diplomacy and peace deals. My question: does Jared Kushner fit the rider who looks like peace?
- **Red Horseman (Rev 6:4):** peace taken from the earth. My question: does Benjamin Netanyahu's leadership fit it? This is about leaders and policies, never about Jewish people.
- **Black Horseman (Rev 6:5-6):** the balances. My question: is Peter Thiel's Palantir, weighing everyone's data, the pair of balances?
- **Pale Horseman (Rev 6:8):** Death. My question: is it possible the man in charge of America's health, RFK Jr., fits the pale rider? Demand the evidence before trusting anyone selling a health revolution.

Being named in Epstein records is not proof of wrongdoing; I ask questions and correct myself in the open.

After it comes the new heaven and new earth, where the truth is known by everyone.

title: The 2002 Video (CGI Alien Interview)
text:
# The 2002 Video

In 2002 I downloaded a video off LimeWire: a speaking Grey in a "Project Blue Book 1964" interview, yellowish, grainy, with muddy audio. 2002 is just when I first downloaded it, years before YouTube existed, so it had to be made before that. The Grey is CGI. The real questions are when it was made and who made it.

text:

The being talks about a nuclear catastrophe, says they are our descendants, describes time travel and warns about fear and dogma. It is a future-human warning, not an interrogation. It is EBE-3.

text:

text:

text:
## The 1959 problem
The title card names the Air Technical Intelligence Center in 1964, but ATIC was renamed in 1959. A real 1964 file would not carry that name.

title: MH370 Theory
text:
# MH370 Theory

In memory of the 239 people aboard Malaysia Airlines Flight 370, March 8, 2014. Their families still deserve answers.

title: MH370 Theory: My theory
text:
## My theory
MH370 was not lost. It was intercepted in a preplanned, classified military operation using technology reverse-engineered from recovered craft. Three synchronized plasma orbs formed a coherent field around the aircraft and moved it intact through a temporary spacetime connection. The terminal flash is the moment of transition, a rapid phase collapse, not a conventional explosion. It is a jump, not an explosion.

- **Three nodes:** the orbs form a triangular phased array around the 777.
- **The field leads:** dark thermal trails sit ahead of the bright orbs.
- **The flash:** the clouds light up as the field reaches its transition state. An explosion composited in later would not light the real clouds.
- **The fourth orb:** a phase-matched receiver at the destination completes the bridge.

title: MH370 Theory: The two 2014 videos
text:
## The two 2014 videos
A thermal (FLIR) drone view, which I believe came from an MQ-9 Reaper sensor, and an overhead satellite view, which I read as Gorgon Stare-style wide-area imagery screen-recorded from a remote Citrix workstation. The on-screen coordinates, 8.834301, 93.19492, sit near the Nicobar Islands, along the westward path military radar tracked.

title: MH370 Theory: Why I believe the videos are real
text:
## Why I believe the videos are real
Two cameras at two frame rates (about 6 fps imagery under a smooth cursor), a stereo pair with real parallax, coordinates that fit the radar path, no compositing seams after the flash, and nobody has ever reproduced both videos at the same detail. MH370's final Inmarsat log-on at 00:19 UTC was two messages eight seconds apart with very different frequency offsets. My read: the plane moved intact and its SATCOM woke up on the other side.

title: MH370 Theory: The added assets
text:
## The added assets
Debunkers matched the flash to Pyromania's SHOCKWV.MOV and the clouds to Jonas De Ro stock photos. Those matches are real. My Altered-Original hypothesis: real footage was edited before or during release, and the assets were added so it would get debunked. If you want something real buried, you make it look fake. A June 8, 2014 RegicideAnon post listed a "WithHud" version that has never surfaced.

title: MH370 Theory: Questions I keep asking
text:
## Questions I keep asking
- Twenty Freescale Semiconductor employees were aboard. My theory: the operation was meant to recover those people or something they carried. Otherwise, why not just shoot the plane down?
- Where did it go? My theory: a classified US operation to Diego Garcia.
- Was Lt. Cmdr. Edward Lin, a Navy surveillance-squadron officer convicted in 2017 on lesser charges, connected to RegicideAnon or the videos? That is my question, not a proven fact; no public record links him to it.
